what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Georgia in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7794 Georgian asylum seekers in Italy, 27.0% of all asylum seekers from Georgia.
Refugees from Georgia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, the United States and Ireland.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Georgia in these years: over South Ossetia territory in 2008.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Georgia.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 41 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
